record.field: Bulk Bag - A large sized flexible, intermediate bulk container
Bottle - A container with a round neck
Container, MAC-ISO (Military Airlift Container - International Standards Organization) Light Weight 8x8x20 Foot Air
Multiwall Container Secured to Warehouse Pallet
Cube - Box with a flexible bladder interior
Drum - Cylindrical large container with removable or sealed top
Liner Bag Liquid - A rubber liner used in a standard container for liquid material
On Hanger or Rack in Boxes
Jug - A bottle (usually 1/2 gallon or larger) fitted with a handle
MILVAN - Military Van - A 20-foot transportation van that conforms to ISO standards
MSCVAN - Military Sealift Command Van - A 35-foot transportation van

Overwrap - A cardboard bottom is put down on a pallet; the bags are stacked in layers; the top of the cardboard slides down over the bags to meet the bottom; if any of the bags tear, the product always stays inside the cardboard
Liner Bag Dry - A plastic liner used in container designed for the carriage of dry free-flowing material
Slip Sheet - Shipping containers utilizing slip sheets, which are cardboard platforms used to hold product for storage or transportation
SEAVAN - Sea Van - A commercial or military 40-foot transportation container that conforms to ISO standards
Triwall Box - A sturdy box made of three-ply cardboard
Tote Can - A reusable stainless steel container with handles; used for liquid material
SOLAS (Safety of Life at Sea) Verified Container Weight
Chargeable Dunnage - The weight of material used to protect material in transit for which a charge is paid
Nonchargeable Dunnage - The weight of material used to protect material in transit for which there is no charge
Storage in Transit Final Weight Out
Non Transit Weight (On Transit Bills Only)
